recommended_approach: Bottom-up purpose model with endogenous interest and explicit revenue scenarios
rationale: Maps ageing, service demand, excess costs, defence, revenue and interest feedback into auditable category paths; its assumptions can be replaced directly as policy information improves.

recommended_approach: Selection remains open across the augmented specifications
rationale: Real GDP per capita is included in every family. Population is excluded from the headline equations because it has no clear scale interpretation in a spending-to-GDP model and is highly collinear with age composition and income. Forecast fit, economic interpretation, stability and cointegration evidence are assessed together.

recommended_approach: ARIMAX with real GDP per capita and COVID controls
rationale: Provides a deliberately parsimonious real-income comparison but omits the richer channels in the structural equations; its income coefficient is not statistically robust.

recommended_approach: Bottom-up scenarios plus the spread and sensitivities across all top-down specifications
rationale: No single model captures parameter, specification, policy and macro uncertainty; scenario and model spread are complementary diagnostics rather than probability intervals.
